extracted.name: Turkey dressing
ingredient_lines: 2 large loaves dry white bread (remove all crust), crumb bread
11/2 cups butter,(melt butter over hot water)
instruction_lines: For 10 to 12 pound turkey. Add butter to bread crumbs. Mix thoroughly and add seasoning. Blend mixture lightly with a fork. Use as stuffing.
